key_insight: Natural Language Programming reframes prompts as cognitive artefacts that coordinate reasoning, goals, constraints, and memory across human–AI workflows.
engineering_relevance: The framework suggests designing conversational AI systems with explicit goals, validation criteria, and layered memory to support long-horizon reasoning continuity.
method: Extend traditional NLP through distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning.
Introduce Dialogic Working Memory to describe prompts and conversational states as temporary external memory.
Map BTMA, SKGE, and RMR memory architectures onto episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a theoretical framework and architecture mapping, but reports no datasets, benchmarks, or quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: Treating natural language as an executable specification requires validation mechanisms; the abstract does not establish reliable execution or memory coherence.
paper_title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
